cancelRequest.label: Cancel the request to join {gym}
cancelRequest.title: Cancel this request?
cancelRequest.body: {gym} won't see your request any more. You can ask to join again with its code.

leave.label: Leave {gym}
leave.title: Leave {gym}?
leave.body: Your membership ends now, and your upcoming bookings at this gym are cancelled. To come back, you'd need its join code or a new invitation. Your SimpleFit account stays as it is.

problems.notFound: This is no longer available. The list has been refreshed.
problems.alreadyMember: You're already a member of this gym.
problems.changed: This changed in the meantime. The list has been refreshed.
problems.registration: Finish setting up your account first.
problems.limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
problems.limitedLater: Too many attempts. Try again later.
problems.session: Your session ended. Sign in again.
problems.unknown: We couldn't confirm that. Check your connection and try again.

join.title: Join a gym
join.lead: Enter the code your gym gave you. You'll see the gym's name before anything is sent.
join.label: Gym code
join.hint: Eight characters, like ABCD-EFGH. Capital letters and hyphens are optional.
join.notFound: We couldn't find a gym with that code. Check it with your gym: it may have changed.

preview.heading: Is this your gym?
preview.approval: The gym approves your request before you can book classes.
preview.instant: This gym accepts members straight away when your identity is verified. Otherwise it approves your request first.

join.privacy: The gym sees your name, bookings and attendance. Your training log stays private unless you share it. Joining creates no Fighter or Coach profile and no staff role.

requested.title: Request sent to {gym}
requested.body: The gym decides. Your request is in My gyms until then, and you can cancel it there.

active.title: You're a member of {gym}
active.body: You can see its classes and book a place.

already.title: You're already a member of this gym
already.body: Your account is already a member, so nothing changed.

registration.title: Finish your account first.
registration.body: You can join a gym once your account is set up.

invitations.title: Gym invitations
invitations.lead: Invitations sent to the verified email addresses on your account. Nothing happens until you answer.

empty.title: No invitations right now
empty.body: When a gym invites one of your verified addresses, it appears here. You can also join with a gym's code.

decline.label: Decline the invitation from {gym}
decline.title: Decline this invitation?
decline.body: You won't join {gym}, and it would need to invite you again.
